Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack modifying the legitimate Codecov Bash Uploader tool to exfiltrate environment variables containing sensitive information such as keys, tokens, and credentials from customers' CI/CD environments
Using harvested credentials to breach customer networks and access private repositories
Impacted Systems: Other companies' private repositories including HashiCorp, Twilio, Confluent, Coalition, Rapid7, Monday.com
Attack Vector: Compromised Codecov Bash Uploader tool in CI/CD pipelines
Misuse of stolen authentication credentials to access private GitHub repositories
Indicators of Compromise: Attacker IP addresses associated with the supply-chain attack (as disclosed by Codecov)
Suspicious activity on Mercari's GitHub repositories between April 13th and April 18th, 2021
